edibles.heading: Edibles
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is the Hillcrest and Kennedy Road store at 49 Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104 in Brampton. It is open 24 hours. This is not the Queen Street shop in downtown Brampton. If you are coming along Kennedy or Hillcrest, Unit 104 is the edible counter described here.

Edibles are sealed cannabis foods and drinks. You shop them by pack name, flavour, format, and the milligram details printed on the label. That is a separate category from flower jars and from vapes. Start with the edible page on the live menu, then compare those listings with what is on the shelf.
Posted prices can change. The live menu is the current list, not a promise that a pack will still be there when you arrive. Call 289-206-1181 if you are coming for one specific edible.
Walk in at Unit 104. No appointment is required. Bring valid government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Ask staff to show the edible section and the labelled packs available that visit.

If two people are splitting the trip across Brampton, send the Hillcrest address, not a generic downtown pin. Edible packs at Unit 104 are the packs on this store’s live menu. A Queen Street list is a different list.
Use Hillcrest Avenue and Kennedy Road as the meeting point, not Queen Street West.

vape-disposables.heading: THC Vapes
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is at 49 Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104, on the Hillcrest and Kennedy Road side of Brampton, open 24 hours. Do not confuse it with the Queen Street West store farther into downtown. THC vapes are the vapour-product category at this Hillcrest address.

THC vapes are sealed cannabis vapour items listed by brand, flavour notes, and posted potency. Formats on the shelf change. Check the live menu for what is actually listed rather than assuming a particular hardware style will be in the case. A listed name is the useful detail; a guessed format is not.
Posted prices can change. If a single vape listing is the reason you are crossing Kennedy Road, call 289-206-1181 before you leave. The phone check is for that Hillcrest menu, not for Queen Street.
Walk in at Unit 104 whenever you are nearby. Bring photo ID. Adults 19+ only. Staff can pull the vape section and help you read the current labels.

If you only have a few minutes on Hillcrest, open the live vape page first and write down two or three listed names. At the counter, ask for those names. If a format is not shown on the current menu, do not expect it to appear in the case.
Hillcrest Avenue, Unit 104, is the store. Queen Street West is a different address.

concentrates.heading: Concentrates
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is the 24-hour Hillcrest and Kennedy location at 49 Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104 in Brampton. It is a different store from Blouds Dispensary on Queen Street West. Concentrates at Unit 104 are the extract products on this menu.

Concentrates are packaged cannabis extracts. Listings usually show name, extract style, listed potency, and pack weight. That is not the same as choosing flower by tier or choosing an edible pack. Read the concentrate page, then confirm the same names in the store. If the page and the label do not match, wait and ask.

The live menu is the only current list. Posted prices can change. Call 289-206-1181 if you need one extract confirmed before you travel across Brampton. Ask for Unit 104 so the call stays with the Hillcrest store.
Walk in at Unit 104. No appointment. Bring ID. The counter serves adults 19 and older. Ask to see the concentrate section and compare labelled items on the spot.

Bring the live-menu name, not a nickname from another Brampton shop. Unit 104 posts its own extract list. Staff can help you match that list to the labelled packs on the counter. If you arrived from Queen Street, start over with this store’s page.
Remember the landmark: Hillcrest and Kennedy, not downtown Queen Street.
Refresh the Hillcrest menu before starting your trip across Brampton.

vapes.heading: Nic Vapes
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is the Hillcrest and Kennedy store at 49 Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104 in Brampton. It is open 24 hours. This is not the Queen Street West shop. Nic vapes at Unit 104 are the nicotine vapour listings on this Hillcrest menu.

A nic vape is a sealed nicotine vapour product listed by brand, flavour notes, and pack details. Hardware on the shelf changes. Check the live menu for current formats rather than guessing what will be in the case. This category is separate from THC vapes.
Posted prices can change. If one nic vape name is why you are crossing Kennedy Road, call 289-206-1181 and ask about the Hillcrest list, not Queen Street.
Walk in at Unit 104. No appointment. Bring valid photo ID. Adults 19+ only. Ask staff for the nic vape section and compare labelled units with the names you wrote down.
If you arrived from downtown by mistake, you are looking for 49 Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104. Queen Street West is a different counter.
Write down the listed nic vape names before you leave Kennedy Road. At Unit 104, ask for those names. If the live menu does not show a format, do not plan the stop around it.
Keep nic vapes and flower on separate lists if you are buying both. Staff can move you between labelled sections once you are inside Unit 104.
Hillcrest Avenue is the landmark for this shop.

flowerTiers.heading: Flower Tiers
paragraphs: Kennedy Loud Cannabis is at 49 Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104, on the Hillcrest and Kennedy side of Brampton, open 24 hours. It is not Blouds Dispensary on Queen Street West. Flower tiers are how this store groups dried cannabis on the live menu.

Dried flower is sold by listed name, weight, and posted price. Tier pages let you scan those listings in groups. That is not the same as shopping edibles or concentrates. Open the Hillcrest flower pages, then look for the same names at Unit 104.
Posted prices can change. A Queen Street flower list does not speak for this store. Call 289-206-1181 if one listed name is the reason you are coming to Hillcrest.
Walk in at Unit 104 whenever you are nearby. Bring government-issued photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Ask for the tier you reviewed and match labelled jars to that page.
Use Hillcrest and Kennedy as the meeting point. Send Unit 104, not a generic Brampton pin.

If two people are crossing Brampton, keep the Hillcrest flower pages open—not the Queen Street ones. Inside Unit 104, ask for the tier heading you already reviewed and stay with labelled jars that match.
A tier heading is only a group on the menu. It does not reserve a jar. Confirm the labelled name and weight at the counter.
Kennedy Road gets you close. Unit 104 finishes the trip.
